meta.name: theme-factory
meta.description: Toolkit for styling artifacts with a theme. These artifacts can be slides, docs, reportings, HTML landing pages, etc. There are 10 pre-set themes with colors/fonts that you can apply to any artifact that has been creating, or can generate a new theme on-the-fly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为幻灯片、文档等作品一键套用或生成主题样式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要为不同文档或演示统一配色和字体风格
copy.tagline_en: Apply or generate themes for slides, docs, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need consistent colors and fonts across documents and presentations

howto.what: Claude 能为一整套幻灯片、文档、报告、HTML 页面等作品套用统一的颜色和字体主题。它有 10 个预设主题可选；若都不合适，可根据你的描述生成新主题并应用到作品上。
howto.when: 当你请 Claude 给已有作品（幻灯片、报告、网页等）应用主题样式，或表达想查看主题、生成自定义主题时触发。

say.text: 帮我把这套幻灯片用 Ocean Depths 主题重做一下
say.note: 会套用该主题的颜色和字体。

say.text: 给我看看现有哪些主题
say.note: 会展示 theme-showcase.pdf 供挑选。

say.text: 做一个森林色调的演示文档主题并应用
say.note: 会生成新主题并应用到当前文档。

howto.what_en: Claude can apply a unified color/font theme to artifacts like slide decks, docs, reports, or HTML pages. It offers 10 preset themes, or can generate and apply a new custom theme from your description.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to theme an existing artifact (e.g., slides, reports, web pages), want to view available themes, or request a custom theme.

say_en.text: Restyle this slide deck with the Ocean Depths theme.
say_en.note: Applies that theme's palette and fonts.

say_en.text: Create a forest-toned theme for this doc and apply it.
say_en.note: Generates and applies a new custom theme.
